description: The viewpoint is from the hillside above Panarea at midday, the whitewashed village cascading down the slope at the left. Turquoise volcanic shores fill the center and right, scattered with dark basalt rocks and small boats, while the perfect cone of Stromboli rises on the horizon at the center. The modelled 23 September 2026, 12:07 light is brilliant and clear, the white cubes of the village glowing against the deep blue sea.
